tagline: Find your people, find your night.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: What's happening in Brooklyn this week?
sections.subheadline: Search 2,400+ events, classes, and meetups happening near you.

sections.name: category_chips
sections.description: Horizontal scrollable category chips with icons: All, Music, Art, Food & Drink, Sports, Tech, Outdoors, Wellness, each in its own brand color at 15% opacity.

sections.name: featured_carousel
sections.description: Coral-bordered featured events carousel with 3 large cards like 'Sunset Rooftop Vinyl Night @ Westlight', 'Bushwick Open Studios 2024', and 'Brooklyn Night Bazaar: Lunar Edition'.

sections.name: this_weekend
sections.description: Grid of 6 weekend event cards with photo, date pill, and attendee count, e.g. 'Prospect Park Drum Circle' (Sat, 142 going), 'Sourdough 101 with Anna' (Sun, 18 going), 'McCarren Park 5K Fun Run' (Sat, 380 going).

sections.name: new_on_platform
sections.description: Strip of newly listed events with a 'NEW' badge, like 'Analog Photography Walk in DUMBO', 'Korean Tea Ceremony Workshop', and 'Founders & Coffee at Devoción'.

sections.name: popular_organizers
sections.description: Horizontal strip of organizer avatars with follower counts, e.g. 'House of Yes' (24.1k), 'Brooklyn Brainery' (18.7k), 'Ridgewood Market' (9.3k).

sections.name: footer
sections.description: Footer with city picker (currently Brooklyn, NY), links to Help Center, Organizer Resources, Trust & Safety, plus social icons.

sections.name: search_bar
sections.headline: Find events in Brooklyn, NY
sections.subheadline: Toggle between List and Map view.

sections.name: filter_sidebar
sections.description: Left sidebar with collapsible filters: Date (Today/Tomorrow/This Weekend/Custom), Category checkboxes, Price (Free / Under $25 / $25+), Distance slider (0–15 mi), Format (In-person / Online).

sections.name: results_grid
sections.description: Grid of 12 event cards with photo, category color tag, title, date in coral, venue with pin icon, price, and attendee count, e.g. 'Latin Night at Casa Pública' ($15, 89 going), 'Free Yoga in Domino Park' (Free, 210 going), 'Indie Game Devs Meetup' ($5, 'Last 4 spots' badge).

sections.name: map_view
sections.description: Toggleable Mapbox-style map with pulsing cobalt markers clustered around Williamsburg and Bushwick, with a hover preview card for the selected event.

sections.name: hero_header
sections.headline: Sunset Rooftop Vinyl Night — Jazz & Soul Edition

sections.name: event_meta_bar
sections.description: Sticky bar with date pill, location with pin, organizer name 'Wax & Wine Co.' with follow button, share icon, and coral 'Get Tickets' CTA.

sections.name: about
sections.description: Short description block describing the rooftop vinyl listening session with featured DJs Marcus Ellis and Lina Park, plus highlights like skyline views and natural wine bar.

sections.name: whats_included
sections.description: Checklist of inclusions like '1 welcome drink', 'Access to listening lounge', 'Vinyl raffle entry'.

sections.name: schedule
sections.description: Vertical timeline: 6:00 PM Doors, 6:30 PM Marcus Ellis set, 8:00 PM Lina Park set, 9:30 PM Open decks.

sections.name: tickets
sections.description: Ticket type cards: 'Early Bird' $28 (sold out), 'General' $38 (47 left), 'VIP Lounge' $75 with 'Last few spots' coral badge.

sections.name: location_map
sections.description: Embedded map with single pulsing marker at 111 N 12th St, plus subway lines L/G nearby.

sections.name: attendee_collage
sections.description: Collage of 24 attendee avatars with '+312 going' counter and 'Invite friends' link.

sections.name: similar_events
sections.description: 3 similar event cards like 'Brooklyn Soul Sundays', 'Greenpoint Listening Bar Pop-up', 'Bushwick Block Disco'.

sections.name: profile_header
sections.headline: Wax & Wine Co.
sections.subheadline: Vinyl-forward rooftop nights across NYC · Verified Organizer

sections.name: stats_strip
sections.description: Row of stats: 4.9★ avg rating, 12.4k followers, 86 events hosted, 9,200 attendees served, with a coral 'Follow' button.

sections.name: upcoming_events
sections.description: Grid of 4 upcoming events like 'Sunset Rooftop Vinyl Night', 'Bossa Nova Brunch', 'Halloween Disco Inferno'.

sections.name: past_events
sections.description: List of past events with attendance bar charts, e.g. 'Summer Soul Series' (sold out, 412 attended), 'Spring Jazz Picnic' (340 attended).

sections.name: reviews
sections.description: Snippet reviews from attendees Jess T., Diego R., and Priya M. with star ratings and event tags.

sections.name: form_header
sections.headline: Let's get your event live
sections.subheadline: Takes about 5 minutes. Save as draft anytime.

sections.name: basics_step
sections.description: Form fields for Event title, Description (rich text), Category dropdown with color chips, Date/time pickers, and Location autocomplete or Online link toggle.

sections.name: tickets_step
sections.description: Repeatable ticket rows like 'Early Bird $20 · qty 50', 'General $30 · qty 150', 'VIP $60 · qty 20' with a 'Add ticket type' button.

sections.name: media_step
sections.description: Cover photo uploader with 16:9 crop guide and recommended dimensions 1600x900, plus optional gallery of up to 6 images.

sections.name: preview_publish
sections.description: Right-side sticky preview card showing how the event will appear in search, with 'Save Draft' and coral 'Publish Event' buttons.
